name: codex-tuner
description: Plan tasks, verify behaviour, review candidates and deliver within the authorized local, draft, pull request or merge scope.

interface.longDescription: Use spec and run to carry a task through verification and its authorized delivery stage. Independently verify a feature, audit a candidate, load repository rules or configure the workflow.
defaultPrompt: Turn this task into an executable specification.
